text: The purpose of this report is to respond to a request from Etobicoke York Community Council that directed the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke-York District to report back at the May 2, 2018 meeting of Etobicoke York Community Council on the feasibility of installing a pedestrian drop-off area on Judson Street at Royal York Road, and as to provide preliminary costs for design and construction. This request was made by the local Councillor as a result of the frequent illegal stopping of vehicles on the east side of Royal York Road to drop-off passengers destined to the nearby Mimico GO train station. An examination of the available roadside space on Judson Street, west of Royal York Road, has revealed that a parking lay-by for passenger pick-up and drop-off is feasible and can be constructed on the south side of the road from a point 15 metres west of Royal York Road to a…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, in consultation with the Director, Community Planning, Etobicoke York District, to report to the July 4, 2018 meeting of the Etobicoke York Community Council on the feasibility of implementing a new, large intersection with traffic controls, spanning Royal York Road from Judson Street to Cavell Avenue, with the south-bound light at Judson Street and the north-bound light at Cavell Avenue. 2. Received the report (April 16, 2018) from the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, for information.
